newsitem.title: UK: Duff & Phelps ups Hungary's foreign currency debt.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps ups Hungary's foreign currency debt.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said on Monday it upgraded the Republic of Hungary's foreign currency obligations to BBB from BBB minus.
"The comprehensive reform package, which was introduced in March 1995, has led to increased macroeconomic stablilisation," the rating agency said in a statement.
"The Hungarian economy has started to respond to the reform process in place," the agency added.
"The economy displays continued signs of economic recovery in 1997 in terms of rising industrial production and gross fixed capital investment."
Duff & Phelps said it expected the overall favourable trends in Hungary to continue.
"Hungary's continued progress on structural reforms and integration with the international economy would provide a competitive and sustainable economic environment in the future."
